input.title: Unclear scope of "Baustelleneinrichtung herstellen"
input.message: The short text does not specify which facilities, equipment, or installations are to be provided. This violates VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which requires clear and exhaustive descriptions.
input.suggestion: Add a detailed list of required items (e.g., site offices, storage containers, sanitation facilities) with dimensions, material specifications and applicable standards (STLB‑Bau).
